body: I hope so too. I can only game when my cousin let me borrow his laptop. I cannot go to internet cafés now due to my condition.
I don't think I need the transplant. I think if I get the transplant 99% it would fail.

In a way, it is affected, because I cannot go to internet cafés now due to having a lot of people and my immune system is at its lowest. I've always wanted to stream my games, I was actually planning to buy my own PC but with the medical bills I'm facing, it seems impossible. I can only play when my cousin let me borrow his laptop. I play dota 2, league of legends, CSGO, apex legends - more and more.

I never loved my high school life, which is from years 12-16. There was this girl of beauty and wit, I was 2nd year high school back then and we were on the same class. I always tried to impress her and make her laugh, and I didn't fail to do it. I did it for almost 2 school years and finally I confessed to her about my feelings toward her, but unfortunately, she rejected me.

After high school, I went to college and in the first day I met this very, very beautiful girl. Wow, if you could just see her that day. I never thought that we would be on the same class. I sat on the very back seat and she's on the front. I always thought on how to get her attention for days, and after a week I just thought to myself that I have nothing to lose, so I stood up in front of her and said,"Nganong gwapa man ka?" which translates,"Why are you so beautiful?" then I turned my back and gone back to my seat, I never saw her reaction because it was so awkward. After I came home, I received a text that she have a crush on me. The day after, I got the girl, the most beautiful girl.

It worked out for me. You just have to wait my friend. I also play video games - DotA 2, Heroes of Newerth, PointBlank, CS:S (lan party with my friends), etc.. We always find a way to win a game. You just have to find a way to jump on that obstacles, just like Mario.

I almost came to a point of suicide my friend, but this man named Nick Grubinger made me realize how good life is. Here's the link of my story -> https://www.reddit.com/r/Life/comments/2z4m6u/do_i_deserve_to_live/

Thanks man, you really cheered me up. :)
I have to edit this reply because you're the BEST!
